item.title: JukeANator Digital Jukebox Conversion Kit (You supply your own bill acceptor/touchscreen and create your own bezel/marquee)
item.description:
Hardware:
- Dell Optiplex GX 620 Small Form Factor
- KeySpan Remote Control (configured to pause/reject/volume up/volume down)
- CyberPower CP425HG 425VA/255W UPS Battery Backup (with automatic shutdown when on battery power for > 5 min)
- Hagstrom Electronics KE-18 Keyboard Encoder (to interface between the bill acceptor/coin acceptor and the PC/software)
Software:
- Windows XP (or Windows 7, depending upon availability)
- JukeANator Commercial (either ASCAP/BMI/SESAC Paid Public Performance Licensing version for U.S./Puerto Rico or normal commercial version for international)
- Keyspan Infrared Remote controller
- CyberPower UPS driver
- ELO Touch Screen driver
